# Astec Showcases Telestack Dry Bulk Material Handling Expertise at Breakbulk Americas 2026


Visitors to Booth C47 will have the opportunity to engage with Astec’s specialists…


September 22, 2026


Share:


**CHATTANOOGA, Tenn.** – Astec Industries, will exhibit at Breakbulk Americas 2026, showcasing[Telestack](https://www.telestack.com/) industry-leading material handling solutions designed to help ports, terminals, shipping operators, and bulk material producers improve efficiency across the movement and storage of dry bulk materials.


Visitors to Booth C47 will have the opportunity to engage with Astec’s material handling specialists and learn how Telestack solutions support ship loading, stockpiling, reclaiming, truck unloading, and other critical bulk handling applications.


As demand continues to grow for efficient movement of dry bulk commodities, operators face increasing pressure to maximize throughput, reduce handling costs, and make better use of existing infrastructure. Telestack’s material handling portfolio addresses these challenges through flexible solutions designed to improve material flow while reducing unnecessary handling and operational bottlenecks.


A key focus of the exhibit will be the company’s expertise in dry bulk material handling applications. While many material processing solutions are traditionally associated with aggregates, Astec’s portfolio extends into a wide range of bulk commodities, supporting applications in ports, terminals, industrial facilities, biomass operations, and mineral handling environments.


“Breakbulk Americas brings together many of the organizations responsible for moving and managing bulk commodities across North America,” said Alan Gulmore, Regional Sales Manager. “It’s an opportunity for us to demonstrate how our material handling expertise can help customers improve efficiency, control costs, and adapt to changing operational demands.”


Attendees will be able to explore solutions supporting:


- Dry bulk material handling
- Ship loading and unloading
- Mobile stockpiling and reclaiming
- Port and terminal operations
- Flexible infrastructure expansion


Telestack will also feature the TB52 All-Wheel Shiploader model and application examples demonstrating material handling solutions operating in challenging bulk material environments.


Breakbulk Americas 2026 will take place September 22-24 in Houston, Texas. Attendees are invited to visit Telestack material handling experts at Booth C47 to learn more about the company’s material handling capabilities and discuss operational challenges with members of the team.

## About Astec


Since 1972, Astec Industries, Inc. has been connecting communities by providing innovative rock to road solutions for our customers. United by our purpose – Built to Connect – Astec is a leading global manufacturer of specialized equipment for asphalt road building, aggregate processing and concrete production. Operations are divided into two primary business segments. Infrastructure Solutions includes road building, asphalt and concrete plants, thermal and storage solutions. Materials Solutions includes aggregate and other material processing solutions. For more information, follow us on social media.
